purpose: Independent factual context for scientific-defense grading; no per-option scores or agent labels.

EMERALD.title: EMERALD · randomized phase 3
EMERALD.finding: Randomized phase 3; primary PFS analyses included all patients and ESR1-mutated patients; prior CDK4/6 therapy was required.
EMERALD.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

ELAC-FDA.title: FDA · elacestrant benefit assessment
ELAC-FDA.finding: The FDA efficacy population is ESR1-mutated disease; EMERALD required prior CDK4/6-containing therapy.
ELAC-FDA.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

EMERALD-DURATION.title: EMERALD · prior-duration subgroup analysis
EMERALD-DURATION.finding: The >=12-month prior ET+CDK4/6 analysis is post hoc and exploratory, without adjustment for multiple testing.
EMERALD-DURATION.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

CAPITELLO.title: CAPItello-291 · randomized phase 3
CAPITELLO.finding: Dual primary PFS analyses were overall and PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered populations; 69.1% previously received CDK4/6 inhibitors.
CAPITELLO.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

CAPI-LABEL.title: TRUQAP · prescribing information
CAPI-LABEL.finding: The indicated population has a qualifying PIK3CA, AKT1 or PTEN alteration; this does not require PIK3CA alone.
CAPI-LABEL.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

DB06.title: DESTINY-Breast06 · randomized phase 3
DB06.finding: Randomized phase 3; primary PFS population was HER2-low; ultralow analysis was exploratory; no prior metastatic chemotherapy.
DB06.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

TDXD-FDA.title: FDA · T-DXd in HER2-low / ultralow disease
TDXD-FDA.finding: The indicated phenotype includes HER2-low and HER2-ultralow after endocrine therapy. Regulatory inclusion does not make both analyses confirmatory.
TDXD-FDA.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

DB06-TTP.title: DESTINY-Breast06 · prior endocrine/CDK4/6 duration analysis
DB06-TTP.finding: Duration subgroups were specified post hoc; benefit was reported across prior ET+CDK4/6 progression-time groups.
DB06-TTP.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

IMLU-FDA.title: FDA · imlunestrant monotherapy
IMLU-FDA.finding: EMBER-3 supports ESR1-mutated monotherapy; prior AI with or without CDK4/6 exposure was permitted.
IMLU-FDA.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

EMBER3.title: FDA · imlunestrant + abemaciclib
EMBER3.finding: The combination comparison was primary in the overall population. Its ESR1-mutated subgroup was exploratory; the FDA indication is ESR1-mutated.
EMBER3.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

EMBER3-PRIMARY.title: EMBER-3 primary publication
EMBER3-PRIMARY.finding: EMBER-3 randomized patients after AI with or without CDK4/6 therapy; primary analyses differed between monotherapy and combination.
EMBER3-PRIMARY.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

VERITAC2.title: FDA · vepdegestrant / VERITAC-2
VERITAC2.finding: The FDA efficacy population is ESR1-mutated disease in the randomized VERITAC-2 trial.
VERITAC2.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

VERITAC2-PRIMARY.title: VERITAC-2 primary publication
VERITAC2-PRIMARY.finding: VERITAC-2 required previous CDK4/6 and endocrine therapy; ESR1-mutated and overall PFS were primary analyses.
VERITAC2-PRIMARY.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

GEDA-FDA.title: FDA · VIKTORIA-1 PFS comparisons
GEDA-FDA.finding: VIKTORIA-1 Study 1 randomized the PIK3CA-mutation-not-detected population; triplet and doublet had distinct fulvestrant comparisons.
GEDA-FDA.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

GEDA-LABEL.title: REVTORPYK · prescribing information
GEDA-LABEL.finding: Study 1 required progression after CDK4/6 plus non-steroidal AI; baseline ECOG was 0 or 1. This does not validate longer-duration enrichment.
GEDA-LABEL.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

ALPEL-LABEL.title: PIQRAY · prescribing information
ALPEL-LABEL.finding: SOLAR-1 supports PIK3CA-selected disease but is not a dedicated randomized modern post-CDK4/6 trial.
ALPEL-LABEL.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

BYLIEVE-2024.title: BYLieve cohort A, 2024 report
BYLIEVE-2024.finding: Cohort A was noncomparative phase 2 after immediate CDK4/6 plus AI. ECOG <=2 was eligible; no randomized treatment-effect contrast is supplied.
BYLIEVE-2024.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

DATO-PRIMARY.title: TROPION-Breast01 · primary phase 3 results
DATO-PRIMARY.finding: Randomized phase 3 TROPION-Breast01 evaluated PFS after endocrine therapy and one or two chemotherapy lines.
DATO-PRIMARY.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

DATO-FDA.title: FDA approval summary · TROPION-Breast01
DATO-FDA.finding: The studied/indicated setting follows endocrine therapy and chemotherapy. Prior CDK4/6 exposure was mixed.
DATO-FDA.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

TROPICS2.title: FDA · sacituzumab govitecan / TROPiCS-02
TROPICS2.finding: TROPiCS-02 randomized patients after CDK4/6, endocrine therapy and taxane exposure, with substantial prior metastatic chemotherapy.
TROPICS2.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

OLYMPIAD.title: OlympiAD · olaparib randomized phase 3
OLYMPIAD.finding: Randomized OlympiAD supports germline-BRCA, HER2-negative metastatic disease; it is not dedicated post-CDK4/6 sequencing evidence.
OLYMPIAD.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

OLAP-NCI.title: NCI · olaparib use in breast cancer
OLAP-NCI.finding: Olaparib selection uses qualifying germline BRCA alteration and prior chemotherapy/endocrine context.
OLAP-NCI.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

POSTMONARCH.title: postMONARCH · randomized phase 3
POSTMONARCH.finding: Randomized phase 3 after prior CDK4/6 plus endocrine therapy; primary PFS was investigator-assessed; benefit appeared across major subgroups.
POSTMONARCH.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

PDQ.title: NCI · breast cancer treatment PDQ
PDQ.finding: Treatment overview supports contextual sequence reasoning; it is not a candidate-specific randomized capecitabine effect estimate.
PDQ.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending

CAPE.title: Capecitabine · prescribing information
CAPE.finding: Regimen-specific prescribing information supports safety review, not an invented post-CDK4/6 comparative HR.
CAPE.review_method: Assistant checked primary publication/official assessment; oncology adjudication pending
